stories.title: Ada Twp. residents rally against DeVos heliport proposal over noise concerns
stories.summary: Ada Township residents voice strong opposition to a proposed private helipad by the DeVos family, citing noise and disruption concerns.

stories.title: Raising Cane's grand opening in Walker expected to draw crowds, offers year of free meals to first customers
stories.summary: Raising Cane’s opens its doors in Walker, offering free meals for a year to early customers and pledging local community support, sparking excitement among fans.

stories.title: Ottawa County approves Axon contract, delays license plate reader delivery
stories.summary: Ottawa County commissioners narrowly approved a $14 million contract with Axon while delaying the delivery of 20 license plate readers that have sparked debate.

stories.title: AJ & Ozzy show how training and trust can open doors for people with disabilities
stories.summary: With the help of a service dog named Ozzy, West Michigander AJ's been able to enjoy situations that were previously stressful.

stories.title: 2 teens arrested in early morning Kalamazoo burglary
stories.summary: A business had been broken into around 4:30 a.m. Thursday. Police later arrested two 18-year-olds in connection to the burglary.

stories.title: ‘Almost impassable’: DNR lieutenant describes search for 83-year-old hunter found alive
stories.summary: Search teams worked section by section through a thick swamp before hearing the missing hunter call for help. A DNR lieutenant shares how crews made it happen.

stories.title: Amway Stadium will host Michigan vs. Michigan State soccer game in April
stories.summary: Tickets for the game go on sale Friday at 10 a.m. The game is scheduled for 1:15 p.m. on April 10.

stories.title: Artists wanted to create new work for MLK Park Community Center
stories.summary: Parks and Recreation is partnering with Muse GR to find artists to create pieces that celebrate "the past, present and future of this space and neighborhood."

stories.title: West Michigan food pantries face increased demand amid SNAP cuts, rising costs
stories.summary: Cuts to SNAP benefits in West Michigan are impacting over 10,000 residents, driving increased reliance on food pantries and revealing broader economic consequences.

stories.title: DTE Gas commits to not request a rate change until late 2027
stories.summary: DTE Gas announced it won't file a rate request until late 2027, giving customers nearly two years of relief from rate increases.

stories.title: Rockford hunter trips, accidentally shoots self in foot
stories.summary: Law enforcement are reminding hunters to take precautions while hunting and always practice firearm safety.

stories.title: 'TIS THE SEASON TO RECYCLE | Kent Co. DPW releases holiday recycling guide
stories.summary: This holiday season, the Kent County Department of Public Works aims to reduce landfill waste by encouraging residents to recycle more.
